text:
Maria Nguyen: quick sync — pulling together sprint priorities for the Efficiency Advisor (batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). We need a concise MVP: what are must-haves vs nice-to-haves for this cycle? cc @Ajay Patel @Sam Kim

Ajay Patel: For MVP I'd push: 1) automatic per-route batching suggestions, 2) KV prefix caching telemetry + recommended TTLs, 3) a single quantization suggestion (manual + recommended steps). Alerts can be a simple eval-regression webhook (eval drop > X%). Keep UI minimal.

Sam Kim: Agree. Also need gating: must have guardrails for quality regressions — paired evals on canary. Implementation note: batching suggestions should include sample payload, expected cost delta, and p95 latency impact. We can reuse existing telemetry streams.

Lina Wu: From CS: top ask is deployable config snippets and a tiny how-to. Example snippet we could export: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","batching":{"max_batch_tokens":4096,"target_latency_ms":200}}
``` SDK should accept this.

Maria Nguyen: Good. Draft acceptance criteria for sprint: (a) recommender produces ranked recs for batching + caching, (b) exportable config snippets (JSON) + SDK consumer, (c) eval-alert webhook that posts regression events, (d) docs + 2 pilot customers onboarded.

Ajay Patel: Rough estimates: recommender POC = 1.5 sprint, export+SDK = 0.5 sprint, eval-alerts = 0.5 sprint. If we need cut, defer automated quant pipeline and ship quant guidance only.

Sam Kim: +1 to deferring auto-quant. Ship quant advisor notes: recommended knobs, safety checks, and an integration checklist for quantizing a model.

Maria Nguyen: Decision for this sprint: MVP = batching recs + caching TTL recs + exportable snippets + eval-alert webhooks. Quantization = advisor notes (post-MVP automation). Action items: @Ajay build recommender POC, @Sam own eval webhook and Slack integration, @Lina docs + pilot outreach. ops-bot will create a tracker.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7321 with sub-tasks: recommender-POC, sdk-export, eval-webhook, docs. Link: https://tracker.internal/INF-7321 :chains:

Lina Wu: I'll ping AcmeHealth and GammaLabs for pilot seats this week and prep two eval prompts (short/generative).

Sam Kim: I'll wire the alert to Slack + PagerDuty initially with a 3% evaluation delta threshold; we can iterate after pilot data :thumbsup:

Ajay Patel: I'll drop a short design doc by EOD with data model for recs, metrics to rank (cost delta, latency impact, quality lift), and a sample API response. Thanks team! :eyes:
